backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app that manages festivals, mantras, aartis, shlokas, temples, community posts, jap counters, kathas, bhajans, and chalisas using in-memory maps, with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two implemented features for the Aarti section: correctly loading and displaying all aarti cards from static data, and showing a graceful Hindi empty-state UI when no data is available.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing the purpose and key fixes applied to each file in the React frontend.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key (stored client-side) and noting that image generation uses Pollinations.ai with no key required.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, primary, muted, border, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the tree in QueryClientProvider and AuthContext, and renders AppLayout as the root layout.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Presentational card component for a single aarti entry that navigates to the aarti detail route on click, displaying a flame icon, name, Hindi text preview, and optional deity tag.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared application shell with a sticky saffron header (logo, admin badge, login/logout button), daily notification banners, an Outlet for page content, and a bottom navigation bar.
frontend/src/components/AuthModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for user login that accepts username/password, calls the useAuth hook's login function, and displays Hindi-language error messages on failure.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: A fixed bottom navigation bar with nine app sections (Home, Panchang, Jap, etc.) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router's state.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble with role-based styling and a text-to-speech control (play/pause/stop) powered by the useSpeechNarration hook, with Hindi detection for appropriate voice UI.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI guru avatar, shown while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/CommunityPostCar: Renders a community post card with author avatar, media attachments (image/video/file), like button, and time-ago timestamp, using Internet Identity for auth-gated liking.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a styled daily dharma quote card with Hindi and English text fetched via useGetDharmaQuote, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita verse while loading.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Shows a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates within a 7-day window, with session-storage-based dismissal persisted per day.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays a festival countdown card showing days remaining until a festival, with a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders animated floating lotus petal images as a fixed background decoration using CSS keyframe animations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: Wraps children in a golden radial-gradient halo glow effect with a pulsing animation, supporting sm/md/lg or numeric size props.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a Hindu katha (story) showing deity emoji, title, excerpt, and category badge, navigating to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Shows a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional loading text, available in sm/md/lg sizes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, showing loading state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Displays a full-screen animated lotus bloom overlay with petal burst particles and a celebratory message when 108 japa counts are completed.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on count and displaying a breathing Om symbol in the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Shows a styled in-app notification banner with a type-specific icon and color scheme, auto-dismissing after 10 seconds via a progress bar countdown.
Renders a brief burst animation of three Om symbols radiating outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that prompts new users to enter their name to set up their spiritual profile, saving it via the `useSaveUserProfile` hook with a default mantra.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on screen when triggered, keeping up to 4 simultaneous ripples that expand and fade out over 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with its Hindi and English meanings in a decorative card, with copy-to-clipboard and native share action buttons.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component showing vrat (fasting) related information including Brahma Muhurat timing and live countdowns to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle UI component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, visually switching between active (amber-themed) and inactive styles using a Switch control.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom hook managing AI chat state with message history persisted to localStorage, providing `sendMessage` and `clearHistory` functions backed by `generateDivyaGuruResponse`.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Provides a simple authentication context with hardcoded admin credentials and basic username/password validation, persisting the logged-in user to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: React hook that schedules 7 daily browser notifications (or in-app banner fallbacks) at predefined IST-friendly hours for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with localStorage persistence for enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity (ICP) authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, delegation validity checks, and exposing identity and login status to consumers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (useQuery/useMutation) wrapping all backend actor calls for entities including Kathayen, CommunityPosts, JapCounter, DharmaQuotes, Bhajans, Chalisas, Vrats, and UserProfiles.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: React hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide Hindi text-to-speech narration with play/pause/resume/stop controls, PWA visibility handling, and retry logic for errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and Tailwind, defining light/dark CSS custom properties for a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon), and declaring utility classes and keyframe animations for the app's Hindu-themed UI.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Utility that queries the Pollinations AI API (with POST, GET, and Mistral fallback strategies) to generate Hindi spiritual guidance responses from a 'Divya Guru' persona, falling back to hardcoded answers on failure.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for the AI Guru feature, including all 12 zodiac signs (Rashis) with metadata and Hindi prediction templates for love and career aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Defines the StaticKatha interface and exports an array of static Hindu religious story entries (kathas) with both Hindi and English text, such as Ramayana stories.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements astronomical calculation functions for Hindu Panchang elements (Tithi, Nakshatra, Vara, Yoga, Karana, Paksha, Sunrise) using Julian Day and planetary longitude algorithms.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Defines the AartiData interface and exports a static array of Hindu aarti texts in Hindi for deities including Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, Durga, and Lakshmi.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider providers.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: Page component that displays a grid of Hindu aarti entries sourced from static data, with each card linking to a detail page.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti, displaying its Hindi text with controls for text-to-speech playback, copying, and sharing. Fetches aarti data from static data by route param ID.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel for managing Kathayen (add/edit/delete with optional MP3 upload) and moderating community posts (approve/reject/delete). Redirects non-admin users to home.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: Chat UI page for the AI spiritual guide (Divya Guru) featuring a message list, typing indicator, suggested prompts, and a text input with clear-history functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Bhajans.tsx: Displays a list of static bhajan cards with expandable lyrics and per-card text-to-speech playback, optionally augmented with backend-fetched bhajans.
frontend/src/pages/Chalisa.tsx: Shows a collection of Chalisa texts (static Hanuman Chalisa plus any backend entries) as expandable cards with text-to-speech support.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page where authenticated users can create posts (with optional image/video) and view approved posts sorted by timestamp; unauthenticated users see a login prompt.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that greets the logged-in user by name and provides navigation guidance, with a loading skeleton while the user profile is fetched.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The Home page displays a hero banner, panchang strip (tithi/nakshatra/vara), a grid of navigation category cards, a daily dharma quote, and a vrat mode banner with floating lotus decoration.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: The Jap page provides an interactive mantra chanting counter with a mala ring UI, tracks daily/lifetime/streak stats via backend queries, and triggers a lotus bloom animation on completing 108 repetitions.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: The KathaDetail page renders a single katha's full Hindi/English text fetched from backend or static data, with an embedded audio player and speech narration controls.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: The Kathayen page lists all kathas (static + backend) with search and category filter tabs (all/puranik/vrat), displaying each as a card with excerpt and deity emoji.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: The Mandir page lists major Hindu temples with live darshan links and Google Maps links, and includes a sacred portal button with a golden ripple animation effect.
frontend/src/pages/Mantras.tsx: Displays a list of Hindu mantras (Gayatri, Mahamrityunjay, etc.) as expandable cards with Sanskrit, Hindi, and English text, plus text-to-speech narration support.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Renders a Hindu Panchang (almanac) page showing daily tithi, nakshatra, vara, yoga, karana, paksha, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious muhurtas with date navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing jap (chanting) stats (daily, lifetime, streak), vrat mode toggle, admin badge, and logout; redirects unauthenticated users to a login prompt.
frontend/src/pages/VratDashboard.tsx: Vrat (fasting) dashboard displaying countdown timers to upcoming Hindu fasts/festivals in 2026, a sattvic food guide, and a daily vrat checklist.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH-based semantic color tokens (saffron, gold, maroon, cream, etc.), custom Hindu-app fonts, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the state of the 'Divya Darshan' devotional app project, recording known issues (Aarti section error), existing fix features, and architectural notes at version 3.
